note: Average NET margins by sub-sector for independent small businesses (industry averages, not promises). All figures are conservative midpoints of published industry ranges and marked est:true. Sources: Toast 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry survey (restaurant margins); Eqvista 2026 / Damodaran data (retail general 5.61%, grocery 1.32%); majc.ai cafe margins 5-15%; financialmodelslab small-inn EBITDA 15-20% (-> net ~10% conservative); fastercapital (grocery 2-3%, luxury retail 10-15%, restaurants 5-10%); SGB Media (specialty apparel ~8.7%). Applied in the simulator's % of revenue view: processing cost as a share of the sub-sector's typical net margin.

grocery.label: Supermarket
grocery.src: Retail grocery & food 1.32% net (Eqvista 2026); grocery stores 2-3% (fastercapital); conservative 2%.

grocery.label: Convenience store
grocery.src: Higher-margin mix (prepared food, tobacco) than supermarkets; conservatively 3%.

grocery.label: Specialty / organic
grocery.src: Premium pricing lifts margins above conventional grocery; conservatively 4%.

grocery.label: Butcher / deli
grocery.src: Service-counter fresh categories carry the best grocery margins; conservatively 5%.

hotel.label: Midscale hotel
hotel.src: Conservative estimate below boutique, above grocery-thin independents.

hotel.label: Boutique hotel
hotel.src: Boutique properties run higher ADR and ancillary spend; conservatively 12% net.

hotel.label: B&B / inn
hotel.src: Owner-operated B&Bs carry minimal staffing; conservatively 15% net.

qsr.label: Café / coffee
qsr.src: Cafe net margins 5-15% (majc.ai); busy independent café conservatively 10%.

qsr.label: Bakery
qsr.src: Conservative estimate in the cafe/QSR band.

qsr.label: Pizza
qsr.src: Toast 2026: QSR/fast casual 6-9% net; pizza conservatively 7%.

qsr.label: Burger / fast food
qsr.src: Toast 2026: QSR/fast casual 6-9%; burger segment at the low end, 6%.

restaurant.label: Casual dining
restaurant.src: Toast 2026: full-service restaurants 3-5% net; independent casual conservatively 4%.

restaurant.label: Family-style
restaurant.src: Toast 2026: full-service 3-5%; family-style runs at the low end, 3%.

restaurant.label: Pub / bar-focused
restaurant.src: Beverage-heavy concepts run well above food-only margins; conservatively 8%.

retail.label: Fashion / apparel
retail.src: Specialty apparel ~8.7% net (SGB Media); luxury 10-15% (fastercapital); independent fashion conservatively 8%.

retail.label: Electronics
retail.src: Thin by design: phones/laptops ~2.4-2.6% (retail margin analyses); conservative 3%.

retail.label: Home goods / furniture
retail.src: Furniture ~2.3-3.9% net in retail margin analyses; conservative 4%.

retail.label: Sporting goods
retail.src: Sporting goods leaders ~6.9% return on sales (SGB Media); independent sporting goods conservatively 5%.

retail.label: Pharmacy / health
retail.src: Conservative estimate near retail-general 5.61% (Eqvista 2026), discounted for independents.

retail.label: Jewelry
retail.src: High gross margins, luxury-adjacent; conservatively 8% net (fastercapital luxury 10-15%).

salon.label: Barbershop
salon.src: Lower product cost and faster turns than full salons; conservatively 12%.

salon.label: Day spa
salon.src: High-ticket services with strong margins; conservatively 12%.

other.label: Warehouse / distribution (B2B)
other.src: Wholesale net margins 2-7% (dojobusiness 2026 survey of wholesale operators); conservative 4% for an independent distributor.

other.label: Dropshipping store
other.src: Experienced dropshippers 15-20% net, avg 10-20% (SaleHoo 2026 / TrueProfit 2026); low end chosen — most stores never reach the middle of the range.

other.label: Web-only store (ecommerce)
other.src: Small ecommerce nets 7.3-20% (alexanderjarvis industry benchmark); typical store ~10% — conservative 8%.

other.label: Mobile services / trades
other.src: Specialty trade contractors: 7.7% net before tax (CFMA 2025 Construction Financial Benchmarker); avg HVAC contractor 6% (Contractor of the Future study) — conservative 7%.

other.label: Market stall / pop-up
other.src: Low-overhead direct retail runs above thin-margin storefront retail (2-6% net); conservatively 6%.
